name: Venn: what to build
yl:
shapes w=10 h=7 "Where does it fit?" caption="The middle is the one to build."
shape circle at=3.8,3 size=4.2 tone=accent +fill +draw
shape circle at=6.2,3 size=4.2 tone=mint +fill +draw
shape circle at=5,5 size=4.2 tone=lavender +fill +draw
shape text Likes at=2.7,2.5
shape text Pays at=7.3,2.5
shape text Can at=5,6.3
shape text Build at=5,3.7

name: Arrow chain: how an ask reaches your phone
yl:
shapes "How an ask reaches your phone" caption="You ask, it lands on the board, a lane builds it, and it ships."
shape@you circle You +grow
shape arrow
shape box Board +fill
shape arrow
shape pill Lane +pulse
shape arrow label=ships
shape circle Phone tone=mint +grow

name: Loop: ask, build, ship
yl:
shapes w=10 h=6 "Round and round" caption="Ask, build, ship. Then you ask again."
shape@ask circle Ask at=5,1.3 size=1.8 +fill +grow
shape@build circle Build at=8,4.6 size=1.8 +fill tone=mint +grow
shape@ship circle Ship at=2,4.6 size=1.8 +fill tone=lavender +grow
shape arc from=ask to=build
shape arc from=build to=ship
shape arc from=ship to=ask

name: Flow: a deploy with a gate
yl:
shapes w=10 h=8 "Deploy" caption="Checks gate the ship. A fail goes back to build."
shape@code box Code at=5,0.9 size=2.6,1.1 +fill
shape@checks pill Checks at=5,3 size=2.6,1.1 tone=butter +pulse
shape@ship box Ship at=7.8,5.3 size=2.6,1.1 tone=mint +fill
shape@fix box Fix at=2.2,5.3 size=2.6,1.1 tone=lavender +fill
shape@live circle Live at=7.8,7.2 size=1.3 tone=mint +grow
shape arrow from=code to=checks
shape arrow from=checks to=ship label=pass
shape arrow from=checks to=fix label=fail tone=mute +dash
shape arc from=fix to=code bend=0.3 tone=mute
shape arrow from=ship to=live

name: Shapes with a choose drawn into them
yl:
shapes w=10 h=4.2 "Where should the extra hour go?" caption="Three places it could land."
shape bracket from=0.8,0.4 to=9.2,0.4 label="one hour" tone=mute
shape@a circle Sleep at=2,2.7 size=2 tone=lavender +fill +grow
shape@b circle Train at=5,2.7 size=2 tone=accent +fill +grow
shape@c circle Cook at=8,2.7 size=2 tone=mint +fill +grow
choose@hour "Pick one" Sleep|Train|Cook

name: Sketch: a setting, before and after
yl:
sketch "Settings" frame=phone before=Now
row "Log out" +hi note="buried at the top"
row "Dark mode" +dim
row "Help" +x note="nobody used it"
after Proposed
row "Dark mode" +dim
row "Log out" +hi note="moved to the bottom"
row "Delete account" +button +dim

name: Sketch: counted in words vs drawn
yl:
sketch "Anything waiting on me?" frame=bubble
row "Two cards are waiting. One has 4 recovered articles and 2 rewrites. The other is the weekly roundup post." +x note="counted in words"
after
row "Recovered articles: 4 and 2 rewrites" +hi note="waiting on you"
row "Weekly roundup: post and link" +hi note="waiting on you"

name: Sketch: a file change, with the choice drawn in
yl:
say "Quieter while you work, same warmth after."
sketch "SOUL.md" frame=window before=Now
row "Warm, quick, a little playful." +x note="removed"
row "Short sentences." +dim
after Proposed
row "Warm and quick. Calm and brief while you work." +hi note="new"
row "Short sentences." +dim
choose@apply "Apply this change?" Apply|"Keep it as is"

name: Sketch: a field that was missing
yl:
sketch "The ZIP field" frame=phone
row "It has a working ZIP field and a two-question form" +x note="described"
after
row "Your ZIP  33410" +hi note="the new field"
row "See My Coverage Options" +button

name: Chart: a line, every point a value
yl:
say "Down a little each day."
chart line "Weight (lb)" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri y=180|179|178.5|178.9|178.2

name: Chart: bars with a goal
yl: chart bar "Protein vs goal" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu y=118|132|141|126 y2=130|130|130|130 names=Protein|Goal unit=g

name: Chart: an area, sleep over a week
yl: chart area "Sleep" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun y=6.5|7.2|5.8|7.6|8.1|9|7.4 unit=h

name: Chart: a donut, where the week went
yl: chart donut "Where the week went" x="Deep work"|Meetings|Email|Admin y=14|9|6|3 unit=h

name: Chart: a pie, lanes this week
yl: chart pie "Cards shipped by lane" x=YUI|SITE|BIZ|OSS y=12|7|3|2

name: Chart: dots with error bars
yl: chart scatter "Rate vs substrate" x=0.5|1|2|4|8 y=0.9|1.6|2.6|3.7|4.5 err=0.2 xlabel="Substrate (mM)"

name: Stat: a number that counts up, with a spark
yl: stat 178.9lb Weight delta=-2.3 spark=181.2|180.6|179.8|178.9 good=down sub="this week"

name: Stat and chart together, a choose drawn under them
yl:
stat $1840 "Grant left" delta=-420 sub="this month"
chart line "Spend by week" x=W1|W2|W3|W4 y=310|480|220|420 unit=$
choose@plan "What now?" "Slow down"|"Keep going"

name: Checklist: today's lifts
yl:
say Today is leg day.
list Today "Squat 5x5" "Romanian deadlift 3x8" "Walking lunges 3x12" "Calf raises 4x15" +check

name: Numbered list: warm-up
yl: list Warm-up "Jumping jacks"|"Hip openers"|"Bodyweight squats"|"Easy jog" +num

name: Table: macros
yl: table Macros Food|Cal|Protein "Eggs|140|12" "Oats|300|10" "Greek yogurt|120|17" "Chicken|220|40" units=|kcal|g

name: Timeline: Yui this week
yl:
timeline "Yui this week"
done "Saved screens" at="Mon" tag=YUI-32
done "Links open Safari" at="Tue" tag=YUI-67
now "Lists on the canvas" tag=YUI-327 sub="rows write in, checks tick"
next "Forms on the canvas" tag=YUI-328
next "Ship the build"

name: Card: leg day
yl: card "Leg day" "Squat, deadlift and lunges. About 50 minutes. Start light." sub="Thursday, 6:30 pm" cta="Start workout"

name: Timeline + choose: what next
yl:
say Build is green.
timeline "Release 0.9"
done "Code frozen" at="Mon"
done "Tests pass" at="Tue"
now "Build uploading" sub="about 20 minutes"
next "Beta review"
choose "What now?" "Wait here"|"Ping me when done"

name: List + table + check: dinner
yl:
list Shop "Eggs" "Spinach" "Greek yogurt" +check
table Totals Item|Cal "Eggs|140" "Spinach|20" "Yogurt|120"

name: Choose with Other: where next
yl: choose@next "Where next?" Legs|Back|Arms +other

name: Pick several: your gear
yl: pick@gear "What gear do you have?" DB|Bench|Bands|"Pull-up bar" submit=Send

name: Slide with end labels: how sore
yl: slide@sore "How sore?" 1-5 Fresh|Wrecked value=3

name: Ask with two buttons: ship it
yl: ask@ship "Ship the site update?" Ship|"Not yet"

name: Form: a 1-10 field and a text field
yl: form@checkin "Check-in" sleep:1-10 goal:text submit=Send

name: Sketch and a choose, a tap on the answer
yl:
sketch "Settings" frame=phone before=Now
row "Log out" +hi note="buried at the top"
row "Help" +x note="nobody used it"
after Proposed
row "Log out" +hi note="moved to the bottom"
choose@move "Move it?" Yes|Later

name: Mixed: a line, a stat, a chart and a question
yl:
say Protein is up. Friday is the gap.
stat 141g Protein delta=9 good=up sub="vs last week" spark=118|132|141|126|141
chart bar "Protein by day" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri y=118|132|141|126|96 unit=g
ask@fri "Fix Friday?" "Add a shake"|"Leave it"

name: Mixed: a sketch, then a list you can tick
yl:
say Move Log out to the bottom. Then tick off what is left.
sketch "Settings" frame=phone before=Now
row "Log out" +hi note="buried at the top"
row "Dark mode" +dim
after Proposed
row "Dark mode" +dim
row "Log out" +hi note="moved to the bottom"
list Ship "Update the screens" "Test on a phone" "Write the note" +check

name: Mixed: a timeline, a card and a question
yl:
timeline "Release 0.9"
done "Code frozen" at="Mon"
done "Tests pass" at="Tue"
now "Build uploading" sub="about 20 minutes"
next "Beta review"
card "Release notes" "Lists, charts and forms now draw on the canvas." cta="Open notes"
ask@notes "Send the notes?" Send|"Not yet"

name: Mixed: a line, a drawing and a pick
yl:
say Where should the extra hour go?
shapes w=10 h=3.4 "One hour to spend"
shape@a circle Sleep at=2,2 size=2 tone=lavender +fill +grow
shape@b circle Train at=5,2 size=2 tone=accent +fill +grow
shape@c circle Cook at=8,2 size=2 tone=mint +fill +grow
pick@hour "Pick one or two" Sleep|Train|Cook

name: Mixed: the question is written first, the picture draws first
yl:
choose@best "Which day felt best?" Mon|Wed|Fri
chart line "Energy" x=Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri y=6|7|9|5|8

name: Mixed: a line, a table and a slider
yl:
say Fish is the cheap protein. How hungry are you?
table Dinner Food|Cal|Protein "Salmon|360|34" "Tuna|180|40" "Chicken|220|40" units=|kcal|g
slide@hungry "How hungry?" 1-5 Peckish|Starving value=3

name: Queue: drag a step, the agent re-dates the rest
yl:
say Drag a step in the queue.
timeline "This week"
done "Saved screens" at="Mon"
now "Lists on the canvas" tag=YUI-327 sub="rows write in, checks tick"
next "Forms on the canvas" tag=YUI-328
next "Charts on the canvas" tag=YUI-326
next "Ship the build" tag=YUI-331
next "Write the note"

name: Parts: drag one next to another
yl:
shapes w=10 h=6 "Plan the build" caption="Drag a part next to another."
shape@plan box Plan at=2,1.6 size=2.6,1.1 +fill
shape@build box Build at=5,4.4 size=2.6,1.1 tone=mint +fill
shape@test pill Test at=8,1.6 size=2.6,1.1 tone=butter +fill
